answer: An agent marketplace for tundra surveys, sable tracking, and jade prospecting requires each bidding identity to lock a bond for 30 days. Each bond buys only one active bid slot, so splitting funds across fake identities cannot create extra capacity for free. An attacker running 1,000 identities must immobilize 1,000 bonds and bear the financing cost for the full lock period; creating new names does not release the funds.
